rules.title: Narrow reactive statements
rules.what: Keep reactive statements and derived values scoped to the data they need; split wide ones into narrow ones.
rules.why: A broad reactive block re-runs whenever any dependency moves, including those that do not affect its result.
rules.how: One $: (or $derived) per derived value; derived stores for shared state.

patterns.note: Reactive block; check that it depends only on what it computes.

verify.how: Each reactive statement depends only on its own inputs.

rules.title: Tear down manual subscriptions
rules.what: Prefer $store auto-subscription; a manual subscribe keeps its unsubscribe and calls it on destroy.
rules.why: A manual store subscription outlives the component unless something unsubscribes.
rules.how: $store in markup; const unsub = store.subscribe(...); onDestroy(unsub).

patterns.note: Manual subscription in a file with no onDestroy/unsubscribe.

verify.how: Mount/unmount cycles leave no subscriber behind.

rules.title: Static by default, measure the output
rules.what: Render non-interactive content statically and measure the generated JavaScript rather than assuming compiled output is small.
rules.why: Compile-time frameworks still ship runtime code per component; hydration of static content is pure overhead.
rules.how: SvelteKit prerender for content pages; csr = false where no interaction; check the build report per route.

verify.how: Build report shows JS per route within budget.
